consequence.statement: Before upgrading to 0.16.0, v1alpha1 must be removed from storedVersions on the externalsecrets, secretstores, clustersecretstores, and clusterexternalsecrets CRDs, as v1alpha1 versions are no longer served in 0.16.0.
consequence.remediation: Run the provided kubectl command to check for v1alpha1 in storedVersions; if present, remove it before upgrading.

original.statement: The v1alpha1 API versions must be removed from storedVersions on externalsecrets, secretstores, clustersecretstores, and clusterexternalsecrets CRDs before upgrading to 0.16.0, where v1alpha1 support is removed from these CRDs.

decision.reason: [ev-07d67e9be26a] lists this as a "Pre Upgrade check" in the 0.16 guide. If the kubectl check reports "NOT SAFE! REMOVE v1alpha1 FROM YOUR STORED VERSIONS", the operator must remove v1alpha1 from storedVersions and persist that status before continuing, so this is a mandatory operator step (migration-required). The rendered diffs show v1alpha1 removed from spec.versions of the externalsecrets, secretstores and clustersecretstores CRDs in 0.16.0 [ev-4a1f27e04efd][ev-04b0055709ca][ev-f978a29a8906], which supports the "no longer served" reason; for clusterexternalsecrets the evidence only shows v1 being added [ev-1061f4fcca14]. Nothing in the evidence says the upgrade itself fails, so migration-required with high severity fits better than upgrade-blocked.
